children: Silver Bow Mining announced Bankruptcy Court approval and completion of the initial closing to acquire the Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex, having funded about $28.58 million into escrow to satisfy creditor obligations.
U.S. Bankruptcy Court approved sale of the Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex to Silver Bow Mining under Section 363.
Company completed the Initial Closing and funded ~US$28.58M into escrow to satisfy specified creditor obligations.
Escrow includes ~US$4.27M for Jefferson County and ~US$20.78M for Montana DEQ; releases to creditors to occur over a few days.
Montana Goldfields issued Silver Bow a senior secured note, guaranteed by Montana Tunnels and secured by property and assets at the Complex.
Final transfer of ownership awaits Final Closing, contingent on shareholder approval of CVR-related share issuance and NYSE American approval.
